messages:
alex.k: PTAL — I pushed the follow-up for #1429, addressed the comments about the shard fallback and split the refactor into a small prep commit + the main change. Added a smoke script at infra/tests/smoke/run.sh and updated the README example. Not sure about the canary timing, would like to avoid peak hours.

maria.s: thanks — skimmed, looks good. two tiny nits: (1) please rename `shardFallback` -> `shard_fallback` to match style, (2) add a one-line comment explaining the heuristic in alloc.go. both optional for canary if you prefer to patch after. :+1:

alex.k: done both, pushed fixup and squashed. kept the heuristic comment short. PTAL again when you have a sec.

sam: quick note — smoke script is fine. can take the canary slot tomorrow 10:30am PT if that works. will monitor latency and error rates for the first 15m.

leo: LGTM from me on the code side, +1 on canary. one question: does the new batching default interact with the runtime profiler? we should watch memory during the canary.

alex.k: good call — I added a profiler flag to the canary command and an alert runbook entry: `alert if heap > 70% for 3m`. command snippet included in the PR description.

canary-bot: Canary scheduled by sam for 2024-11-12T10:30:00-08:00. will run smoke script and collect traces. notify @alex.k @maria.s @leo on anomalies.

maria.s: perfect — thanks. PTAL resolved, moving to canary queue. :rocket:
